floating_environment: round-to-nearest ties-to-even, gradual underflow, DAZ/FTZ disabled, default masked exceptions; floating status flags are not asserted equal.
notes: Every expected value is captured before Rust implementation; input words, output words and F64 sums are retained exactly.
Four-lane prefixes and scalar tails are independently exercised; SIMD exponentials use the frozen no-FMA SSE2 polynomial and integer exponent scaling.

Nonfinite primitive cases are retained separately from graph validation; NaN payload propagation and floating status flags are platform qualifications to be reported, not silently normalized in stored references.
